clue.text: Inform about average saving

indicators.note: the word for inform goes round the word for average, so about signals a container

parts.note: to sing is slang for informing on someone to the police
par is the standard or average level

explanation.surface: An informer tips off the authorities about typical household thrift.
explanation.definitionFit: Being thrifty with money is a matter of economising, as in sparing use of resources.

clue.text: Exchanged by King Richard II for a palmer's walking staff

definitions.text: Exchanged by King Richard II for a palmer's walking staff

parts.words: Exchanged by King Richard II for a palmer's walking staff
parts.note: in Shakespeare's Richard II the deposed king offers to give his royal staff of office for a pilgrim's stick

explanation.walkthrough: The line from Richard II, Act 3, runs 'my sceptre for a palmer's walking staff'; a palmer is a pilgrim.
explanation.definitionFit: The ornamental rod a monarch holds is the symbol of royal power the king would give up.

clue.text: Bond, given a welcome, set about the guys!

indicators.note: set about says one piece is placed around another, a container

parts.note: to greet is to welcome
men are guys

explanation.surface: James Bond gets a warm reception and then sets about the men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bond' suggests the spy 007; it is a binding pact. 'Set about' puts the first piece round the guys.
explanation.definitionFit: A pact or contract binds the parties, like a bond.

clue.text: Putting a writer up in it is absurd

indicators.note: the turned word goes inside it, so in signals a container
in a down clue up means the word is read from bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: a pen is a writing implement

explanation.surface: Putting a writer in charge of it is silly.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' turns the writer's tool backwards, and 'in' puts that inside the word it.
explanation.definitionFit: Clumsy, foolish or out of place, the old sense of inept as silly.

clue.text: Swapping over the gear, as we get warmer

indicators.note: swapping letters over means changing their order

explanation.surface: Someone changes gear and the car gets warmer.
explanation.definitionFit: A fuel-burning room heater is a device that warms.

clue.text: Ecclesiastical converse

parts.note: reads like churchly conversation, but converse is the noun for an opposite: the word that is the reverse of churchly

explanation.walkthrough: 'Converse' looks like a verb or a noun meaning talk; here it means the opposite, so the clue asks for the opposite of church-related.
explanation.definitionFit: Worldly matters, not religious ones, stand opposite to church affairs.

clue.text: Quick trim

explanation.definitionFit: A brisk pace is a smart pace; neat dress is smart dress.

clue.text: Support with disagreeable smile

parts.note: cross means bad-tempered or disagreeable
to beam is to smile broadly

explanation.surface: Someone backs a proposal with a sour grin.
explanation.definitionFit: A horizontal girder in a structure holds up a roof or floor.

clue.text: Left a little land — or that's the yarn

parts.note: an isle is a small piece of land in water

explanation.surface: A sailor's tale of leaving a small island is just a yarn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yarn' looks like a tall story; it is thread, lisle being a fine cotton thread.
explanation.definitionFit: Lisle is a fine twisted cotton thread used for stockings.

clue.text: Book to keep for oneself

definitions.meaning: to book a seat or table in advance
to hold back for one's own use

explanation.definitionFit: Booking a table and holding something back both mean setting it aside.

clue.text: Hen bird rebuffed that's strange!

indicators.note: rebuffed suggests something pushed back, so the word for the hen bird is read backwards

parts.note: a ree, or reeve, is the female of the ruff, a wading bird
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims at the oddity of a hen bird being turned away.
explanation.walkthrough: REE, the female ruff, is old crossword vocabulary; turned back by 'rebuffed' it gives EER, then IE for 'that's'.
explanation.definitionFit: Uncanny and weird things are both spooky and odd, the sense of strange here.

clue.text: In the main they're not mounted

definitions.text: In the main they're not mounted

parts.words: In the main they're not mounted
parts.note: reads as a statement about most horses being unridden, but 'the main' is the sea, where these little fish-horses live and no one rides them

explanation.walkthrough: 'In the main' looks like 'mostly'; it is the poetic word for the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: Small fish with horse-like heads live in the ocean and, unlike real steeds, carry no riders.

clue.text: 14's method of handling

definitions.meaning: a therapist's way of dealing with a patient, from the answer to 14 down
the way someone or something is dealt with

explanation.definitionFit: A therapist offers care for a disorder; the same word means the way anything is dealt with.

clue.text: Vilify senior NCO at attention

parts.note: SM is the abbreviation for sergeant major, a senior non-commissioned officer
to have someone's ear is to have their attention

explanation.surface: A soldier at attention is slandered by a senior sergeant.
explanation.definitionFit: To blacken someone's name is to defame them, the sense of smear as a slur campaign.

clue.text: Bring into play retired actor without a vote

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside: the reversed name goes round the cross
retired suggests something drawn back, so the actor's name is read backwards

parts.note: Herbert Beerbohm Tree was a famous Victorian and Edwardian actor-manager
a voter marks the ballot with a cross, X

explanation.surface: A retired actor is brought back into play despite being denied a vote.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retired' turns TREE into EERT; 'without' means outside, so EERT wraps X. Tree is the actor-manager Sir Herbert Beerbohm Tree.
explanation.definitionFit: To exercise or apply strength or influence is to put it to use.

clue.text: A person prepared to deal with disorder — the strike first

definitions.text: A person prepared to deal with disorder

parts.note: taken as written
a rap is a sharp knock or blow
first is written 1st, read as IST with the figure as a letter I

explanation.surface: A peacekeeper is ready to handle unrest, and strikes first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First' abbreviated as 1ST is read as IST, the figure 1 standing for the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: A clinician who treats mental or physical illness is trained to handle disorders.

clue.text: The people in the list can be located

indicators.note: the word for people sits inside the word for the list, so in signals a container

parts.note: a table is a list arranged in rows, like a league table
a race is a people or nation

explanation.surface: The people named in a register are ones who can be tracked down.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that may be found or tracked down is able to be followed back.

clue.text: Sum granted for building ocean wall

indicators.note: building means constructing, so the letters are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: Money is granted for the construction of a sea wall.
explanation.definitionFit: Money given at regular intervals, like pocket money, is a set amount handed over.

clue.text: The country-woman

parts.note: reads as a rural woman, but means the female figure who personifies a nation, helmeted with trident and shield

explanation.walkthrough: 'Country-woman' suggests a farmer's wife; the hyphen makes it the woman who is the country itself, Britain's emblem on old coins.
explanation.definitionFit: The helmeted female figure with shield and trident symbolises Britain itself.

clue.text: The card possibly inscribed by a novice for the church

indicators.note: possibly says the letters could be arranged another way, so they are mixed up

parts.note: L is a learner, from the L-plate a learner driver displays

explanation.surface: A card perhaps inscribed by a trainee is meant for the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Inscribed by' places A and L among the letters of THE CARD; 'possibly' then rearranges them all.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop's principal place of worship is a major church building.

clue.text: Heavy fall for one using a short cut

definitions.meaning: a bad tumble, as when a rider is thrown from a horse
someone who crops hair or plants, cutting them short

explanation.walkthrough: 'Come a cropper' is a British idiom for a heavy fall; the second sense is one who crops, cutting things short.
explanation.definitionFit: A bad tumble is called coming a cropper; a person who trims things short also crops them.

clue.text: A girl's destiny

definitions.meaning: in Greek thought ... is a person's fate or allotted portion

explanation.definitionFit: It is a woman's name and also the Greek word for fate, one's allotted lot.

clue.text: A lease retained by the sportsman

indicators.note: retained means held inside, so the word for lease sits within the next word

parts.note: to let is to lease out property

explanation.surface: A rental agreement is kept on by the sportsman.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner or competitor in field events is a sportsperson.

clue.text: A foreign character in some gainful occupation

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the words some gainful

explanation.surface: An overseas person is found in some lucrative job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Character' looks like a person; it is a letter of the alphabet, here Greek.
explanation.definitionFit: The last letter of the Greek alphabet is a letter from a non-English script.

clue.text: Equalises after making seven changes

indicators.note: changes says the letters of seven are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone equalises after making seven substitutions in a match.
explanation.definitionFit: Making things level smooths them out, as in to even the score.

clue.text: A report produced like lightning?

parts.note: a bulletin of breaking news, punning on lightning appearing as a sudden flash

explanation.definitionFit: A brief urgent news bulletin comes suddenly, like a bolt in a storm.

clue.text: Roman boundary in the Tyneside area is simple to find

indicators.note: in says the two pieces sit inside the abbreviation for the region

parts.note: Tyneside, round Newcastle, is in the North East of England, abbreviated NE
a boundary in cricket scores four runs, IV in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A Roman frontier in north-east England is easy to locate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roman boundary' looks like Hadrian's Wall; it is a cricket boundary (four runs) written as IV.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unsophisticated and innocent is to be guileless or artless.

clue.text: Compel College head to take a position in the front

indicators.note: taking a position in something means going inside it, a container

parts.note: fore means the front, as in to the fore

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A college head is forced to take up a frontline post.
explanation.definitionFit: To make someone do something by pressure is to coerce them.

clue.text: Abstract one article for a man following orders

parts.note: a precis is a summary or abstract
I is the Roman numeral for one
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A summary written by one person is offered to an obedient man.
explanation.definitionFit: A stickler who keeps strictly to rules is punctilious about observing every instruction.

clue.text: Classify cattle-grazing

definitions.meaning: to arrange things in order or rank
open land where livestock roam and feed

explanation.definitionFit: To place in rows or order is one sense; open pasture for livestock in America is the other.

clue.text: Favour trees to effect a transformation

indicators.note: transformation means a change of form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone kindly asks the trees to change themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Favour' looks like a verb; it is the noun for a ribbon badge worn as a token.
explanation.definitionFit: A favour can be a ribbon or badge worn as a token of allegiance, such as a rosette.

clue.text: Raise tax in the Spanish quarters just the same

parts.note: el is Spanish for the

indicators.note: the tax sits inside the two quarters, so in signals a container

parts.note: E for east is a compass quarter; two identical quarters give E and E
VAT is value added tax

explanation.surface: Someone proposes to increase tax in Spanish districts all the same.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quarters just the same' means the same compass point twice, E and E, with VAT between them.
explanation.definitionFit: To lift something up is to move it higher.
